# Jan Vidovič

> Student developer in Maribor, Slovenia. I build complete products across web, mobile and desktop — and the parts I enjoy most are the ones that make them real: the database, the auth, the deploy.

This is the personal portfolio of Jan Vidovič, a student developer based in Maribor, Slovenia, currently studying computer technician at Prometna šola Maribor.

## What I work with

- **Front end:** React, Tailwind CSS, Vite, JavaScript, TypeScript
- **Back end:** Node.js, Express, PHP, REST, JSON, bcrypt
- **Data:** Firebase, Firestore, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Cassandra, SQL, LDAP DS
- **Desktop and mobile:** .NET / WPF, Flutter, Dart, XAML
- **3D:** Blender
- **Tooling:** Git, Linux, VS Code, Figma

## Projects

- [Scribe](https://scribeslo.vercel.app/): A study planner for school and university students. Subjects, tasks, a timetable imported from a photo with OCR, real-time chat with classmates, and flashcards. React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS and Firebase. [Source](https://github.com/NoctsWRLD/Scribe)
- [NSA_REACT](https://github.com/NoctsWRLD): A full-stack store — a React client over an Express API backed by MongoDB, with registration and login using bcrypt-hashed passwords, and product endpoints for listing and creating items. Source not published.
- [MovieDB](https://github.com/NoctsWRLD): A desktop movie catalogue in C# with WPF — a Movie model, separate windows for adding and editing entries, and a settings screen. Source not published.
- [Odkup rabljenih vozil](https://github.com/NoctsWRLD): A used-car marketplace in Slovenian. PHP over SQL with a shared database handler, and separate include files for registration, login and logout. Source not published.

- KOPIJANOVA D.O.O., Maribor, Slovenia — 2021. Hand-packing school material.

Neither is a software role. They funded his own equipment.
